root_text: 🚨 Breaking: India reports its first case of HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus). An 8-month-old baby in Bengaluru has tested positive. Health officials say no need to panic - it's a common respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms. 🦠 #HMPV #Hea
